title: Manali, Leh & Srinagar (9N/10D)
reportingPoint: The Volvo bus to Manali leaves Delhi at 6:30 PM on Day 0. The exact boarding point is shared once your booking is confirmed. The tour ends in Srinagar.
highlights: Atal Tunnel and Baralacha La, into Lahaul on the Leh-Manali highway
Sarchu, a night under a million stars
Gata Loops and Tanglang La, a day of high passes into Leh
Khardung La (18,380 ft), then Diskit and the dunes
Turtuk, the last village on the Indo-Pak border
Sham Valley and Magnetic Hill, then Kargil and on into Kashmir
overview:
The great Himalayan crossing: the Leh-Manali highway over Baralacha and Tanglang La, Khardung La and Nubra, Turtuk, Pangong Tso, then Kargil and on to Srinagar, by bike or by car. It is a **9 Nights / 10 Days** fixed-departure group trip that starts with an overnight Volvo from Delhi to Manali and ends in Srinagar, with stays in hotels, camps and homestays and 15 meals across the trip.

Travel in a sitting coach (SIC) by Traveller or MUV, ride a Royal Enfield Himalayan solo or with a pillion, or bring your own bike. An oxygen cylinder rides in the car 24x7, with a mechanical backup vehicle and a team captain throughout. Prices start at ₹26,000 per person on triple sharing with your own bike and fuel, or ₹38,000 by SIC (5% GST extra). Reserve your seat with ₹8,000 and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. Batches run every week in the summer season, June to September, when the Leh-Manali highway is open; call us for 2027 dates.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Manali
itinerary.content: Depart Delhi by Volvo bus at 6:30 PM for the overnight journey to Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali: arrival and acclimatisation
itinerary.content:
Check in, freshen up, breakfast and a short trip briefing.
Self-explore Manali: Vashisht Temple, Hadimba Temple, Mall Road and Jogini Waterfall.
Early night at the hotel to rest for the adventure ahead.

itinerary.title: Manali to Sarchu
itinerary.content:
Breakfast, check out and start the famous Leh-Manali highway.
Through the Atal Tunnel into Lahaul, past Darcha and over Baralacha Pass.
Reach Sarchu by evening for a night under a million stars at the camp.

itinerary.title: Sarchu to Leh
itinerary.content:
A day of high passes: the Gata Loops, Nakee La and Lachung La.
Lunch on the More plains at Pang.
Over Tanglang La into Leh. Evening free to acclimatise; overnight in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra via Khardung La
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, ride over Khardung La (18,380 ft).
Visit Diskit Monastery and its 100 ft Buddha; camel and ATV rides are at your own cost.
Check in to the campsite for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Turtuk and back
itinerary.content:
Head to Turtuk, the last village of India on the Indo-Pak border, famous for its apricots.
Walk the village, sun-bask by the Shyok River and visit the Balti Museum.
Back to Nubra for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso
itinerary.content:
Check out after breakfast and head to Pangong Lake, famous from 3 Idiots.
Check in to cottages, explore the lakeside and capture surreal views.
A warm dinner and the night sky over the lake (weather permitting).

itinerary.title: Pangong Tso to Leh via Chang La
itinerary.content:
Over Chang La to Leh, via Thiksey, Shey Palace and the 3 Idiots school.
Overnight in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh to Kargil via Sham Valley
itinerary.content:
Visit the Hall of Fame, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib and Magnetic Hill on the way.
Overnight in Kargil.

itinerary.title: Kargil to Srinagar
itinerary.content:
Ride from Kargil to Srinagar.
Overnight at a hotel in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.content: After breakfast, depart from Srinagar. The tour ends here.

importantNotes:
- **Carry a valid government photo ID.** IDs are verified before boarding, and there is no boarding without one.
- The trip starts with the Volvo from Delhi to Manali and ends in Srinagar. Book your own onward travel from Srinagar.
- Prices are for triple sharing. On the own-bike options, double occupancy is ₹3,000 per person extra.
- You will be travelling through high-altitude cold desert. Consult your doctor before the trip, be physically fit, and tell us about any existing health condition before travelling.
- The itinerary advises Diamox 250 mg (acetazolamide) twice a day, after breakfast and after dinner, starting at least two days before the journey to Leh and continuing for two days after arriving. Check with your doctor before taking it.
- Avoid physical exertion on your first two days in Leh.
- Drink at least 2 to 3 litres of water a day, and avoid alcohol, smoking and sedatives.
- If you notice symptoms of HAPE, HACE or AMS, consult a doctor immediately.
- Only postpaid mobile networks (Jio, Airtel, BSNL) work in the region.
- Hotels in Ladakh are more basic than in other parts of the country. Stays are subject to availability; if a booked hotel is unavailable, you are moved to a comparable property.
- Breakfast on the last day depends on your departure time.
- **Any damage to the bike, except engine damage, is borne by the rider.**
- Prices are per person. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.
- Bookings can't be transferred. Only the names given at confirmation may travel.
- Look after your own luggage and belongings. We aren't accountable for missing items.
- The departure time is fixed. Keep the trip coordinator updated and report at the pickup point 30 minutes early.
- The departure point and time may change. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.
- The AC is switched off in the hills, and the driver may switch it off whenever needed for safety.
- Drinking and smoking are strictly prohibited during the journey.
- Misconduct or indiscipline isn't tolerated. We are a cordial travel community.
- Travel Devils isn't responsible for delays, changes or extra costs from natural hazards, accidents, breakdowns, weather, landslides, political closures or other incidents. Extra days due to weather or snow road blocks aren't included.
- We don't provide insurance for sickness, accidents, theft or other losses.
- Weather, road conditions and participants' fitness may change the itinerary. We may adjust the schedule in the interest of safety, comfort and well-being.

faqs.q: Where does the trip start and end?
faqs.a: The trip starts in Delhi with the Volvo bus to Manali at 6:30 PM on Day 0, and ends in Srinagar after breakfast on Day 10.

faqs.q: What are the travel options and what do they cost?
faqs.a: Per person on triple sharing: sitting coach (SIC) ₹38,000, RE Himalayan with pillion ₹38,000, RE Himalayan solo rider ₹48,000, and your own bike with your own fuel ₹26,000. On the own-bike options, double occupancy is ₹3,000 per person extra. 5% GST is extra.
Summer season only, from June to September, when the Leh-Manali highway is open. Batches leave every week (for example 4 to 14 June through 17 to 27 September 2027). Call us for 2027 dates.

9 nights in hotels, camps and homestays, all meals mentioned in the itinerary, the Volvo from Delhi to Manali, bike rent for 8 days with fuel (bike option) or travel by Traveller / MUV (SIC), a mechanical and luggage backup vehicle, an oxygen cylinder 24x7, inner line permits and the Ladakh union fee, riding gear, a first-aid kit and a team captain.

5% GST, unspecified meals, room heater charges, entry and monument fees, personal expenses and tips, extra days due to weather or snow road blocks, any damage to the bike except engine damage, and costs from medical emergencies.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pick your batch and option, then call or WhatsApp us on +91 88008 41209. Reserve your seat with an advance of ₹8,000 per person by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, and pay the balance 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹8,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. The balance is due 24 hours before boarding, and pending payments may cancel the booking. Bookings can't be transferred.
